import sys,json,hashlib,os
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/vivi/pixelated');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts.training.v6_policy_resolution import DIRECTORY,OUTPUT,DOCS,rows,write,write_rows,configured
from ai.training.contextual_support_policy import ContextualSupportTransport
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv(ROOT/'.env',override=True)
sys.path.extend([str(ROOT/'ai'),str(ROOT/'ai/training')])
from qa.validation.therapy_bench import paired_eval as pe
from run_wandb_paired_eval import WandbAsyncTransport
stage=sys.argv[1]
p=DIRECTORY/'bounded-support-v3'/stage;o=OUTPUT/('bounded-v3-'+stage)
if o.exists():raise RuntimeError('refuse to overwrite existing reviewed run')
arm=json.loads((DIRECTORY/'calibration-v2/gemma4-calibration-config.json').read_text())['arms'][0]
if stage=='original':
 cases=rows(DOCS/'safety-quality-dev-v1.jsonl');template=json.loads((DIRECTORY/'safety-config.json').read_text())
else:
 cases=rows(DIRECTORY/'confirmation/cases.jsonl');template=json.loads((DIRECTORY/'confirmation/config.json').read_text())
config=configured(template,'v6-bounded-support-v3-'+stage,len(cases))
write_rows(p/'cases.jsonl',cases);write(p/'config.json',config)
plan={
 'stage':stage,'responses':2*len(cases),'runtime_receives_labels':False,
 'max_target_calls_per_response':3,'max_router_calls_per_response':1,
 'reserved_all_internal_calls_usd':round(2*len(cases)*(3*(8192*.07+1024*.2)/1e6+(8192*.1+96*.3)/1e6),8),
 'response_origin': 'Explicit boundary templates on seven routed contexts; target model elsewhere. This evaluates middleware, not model weight improvement.',
 'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'cases.jsonl').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'implementation_sha256':hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'ai/training/contextual_support_policy.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'withheld_is_failure':True,'clinical_validation':False,'deployment_authorized':False,
}
write(p/'plan.json',plan)
o.mkdir(parents=True)
class RecordingTransport(WandbAsyncTransport):
 def complete(self,arm,messages,tools,decoding):
  result=super().complete(arm,messages,tools,decoding)
  usage=result.get('usage') or {}
  inputrate,outputrate=(.1,.3) if 'gemma-4' in arm['model'] else (.07,.2)
  item={'model':arm['model'],'messages_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(messages,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),'max_tokens':decoding['max_tokens'],'usage':usage,'finish_reason':result.get('finish_reason'),'response':result.get('response'),'estimated_cost_usd':(usage['prompt_tokens']*inputrate+usage['completion_tokens']*outputrate)/1e6}
  with (o/'all-provider-calls.jsonl').open('a') as stream:
   os.chmod(o/'all-provider-calls.jsonl',0o600);stream.write(json.dumps(item)+'\n')
  return result
raw=RecordingTransport()
t=ContextualSupportTransport(raw,arm,audit_path=o/'routing-audit.jsonl')
request=pe.RunRequest(p/'cases.jsonl',p/'config.json',o,pe.RunnerOptions(max_input_tokens=8192))
write(p/'dry-run.json',pe.build_dry_run_report(request));print(plan,flush=True)
try:
 result=pe.run_paired(request,transport=t);print({k:result[k] for k in ['status','success_count','error_count','estimated_cost_usd']},flush=True)
finally:
 write(o/'routing-audit-final.json',t.audit)
purpose: Exact script used for recorded synthetic development experiment; requires project Python environment and private WANDB_API_KEY. Refuses existing generation output. Never deploys.
